name: MisterTranslate
author: mistertranslate

sections.description:
MisterTranslate translates your WordPress content while keeping your pages exactly as you designed them. No rebuilding, no broken layouts, no wasted hours fixing what the translation broke.

If you use Elementor, WooCommerce or any visual builder, you already know the problem: most translation tools ignore how your content is structured and deliver broken results. MisterTranslate works differently. It detects how your content is stored and translates it segment by segment, preserving every widget, every column and every visual element.

Translate without breaking your design

MisterTranslate understands page builders. When you translate an Elementor page, it keeps the layout, the widget structure and the visual hierarchy intact. The same applies to Avia/Enfold, Gutenberg blocks and the Classic Editor.

WooCommerce ready

Translate product titles, descriptions, short descriptions, categories and attributes. Launch your catalog in new markets without rebuilding product pages one by one.

Control your terminology

The built-in glossary lets you protect brand names, keep technical terms unchanged or define exact translations for key phrases. Your translations stay consistent across every page.

Know the cost before you start

The cost estimator shows you exactly how much a translation will cost before you launch it. No surprises. You always see your available balance inside the admin panel.

Save time with batch translation

Select multiple pages or products and translate them in one batch. Ideal for agencies managing multilingual sites or store owners launching in new markets.

Works with your multilingual setup

MisterTranslate integrates with Polylang and WPML so your translated content links correctly across languages. It also purges WP Rocket cache automatically after translation.

Key Features

  • Translate pages, posts and custom post types from one panel
  • Preserve Elementor layouts with segment-based translation
  • Translate WooCommerce products, categories and attributes
  • Keep terminology consistent with glossary rules
  • Estimate translation cost before launching
  • Process content in batches to save time
  • Connect translated content with Polylang and WPML
  • Purge WP Rocket cache after translation

Supported Builders and Editors

  • Elementor
  • Avia / Enfold
  • WordPress Block Editor (Gutenberg)
  • Classic Editor

Language Support

80+ languages including Spanish, English, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, Russian and Hindi.

Who Is MisterTranslate For?

  • Store owners who need to launch products in new languages fast
  • Agencies who manage multilingual client sites and need to scale
  • Site owners who want to translate landing pages without losing their design
  • Anyone who needs consistent, professional translations with full control over terminology
sections.installation:
1. Upload the mistertranslate folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin in WordPress
  3. Go to MisterTranslate > Settings
  4. Enter your Client ID and Secret Key
  5. Open the MisterTranslate panel and start translating

To get your API credentials, visit mistertranslate.com.
sections.faq:
What does MisterTranslate translate?

Pages, posts, custom post types, WooCommerce products, categories and attributes.

Does it work with Elementor?

Yes. MisterTranslate detects Elementor content and translates it with a segment-based approach to preserve layout and widget structure.

Does it support WooCommerce?

Yes. It can translate product titles, descriptions, short descriptions, categories and attributes.

Can I control brand names or fixed terminology?

Yes. The glossary lets you keep terms unchanged or define specific translations for any term.

Does it work with multilingual plugins?

Yes. MisterTranslate integrates with Polylang and WPML for multilingual linking workflows.

Can I estimate translation cost before starting?

Yes. The plugin includes a cost estimator and shows available balance inside the admin panel.

Is it useful for agencies?

Yes. MisterTranslate is especially useful for agencies and site managers who need to localize multiple pages or products faster without breaking existing layouts.

Do I need technical knowledge to use it?

No. The plugin works from a single panel inside WordPress. Select your content, choose the target language and translate.

Does it break my page design?

No. MisterTranslate is specifically built to preserve your layout. It translates content while keeping page builder structures, widgets and visual elements intact.
sections.changelog:
5.1.6

  • Settings: after saving your Client ID and Secret Key, the connection is now tested automatically and the result is shown, without having to click “Test Connection”
  • Low balance alerts are now measured in WORDS instead of tokens: you set the threshold in words (default: 500) and are alerted when your minimum available words drop below it. Existing token thresholds are migrated automatically
  • Settings: the credential-management and refresh buttons now use the brand orange color and their icons are properly centered
  • Minor admin UI polish for a more consistent look

5.1.5

  • Inline HTML protection: bold, italic and other inline tags are now shielded from the AI with placeholders and restored afterwards, so formatting like 500 words is preserved exactly instead of leaking across the whole sentence
  • Internal link rewriting: links inside translated pages (Elementor, Gutenberg and Classic content) now point to the translated version of the target page in the same language, instead of sending visitors back to the original-language page
  • SEO metadata is now translated (not just copied): SEO title and meta description for Yoast SEO, Rank Math, All in One SEO and SEOPress are sent for translation on the translated page
  • Automatic retry: transient API failures and rate-limit responses are now retried automatically instead of failing the translation
  • Empty-body pages: pages with no translatable body (such as the WooCommerce Shop page or index pages) now translate the title and are created correctly instead of being skipped
  • Duplicate protection: translating a page that already has a translation now detects the existing one and offers Duplicate / Replace / Cancel, preventing accidental duplicated translations
  • Slug collisions: translated pages append the language code to the slug to avoid clashes between languages
  • Elementor: raw HTML widgets (containing , or

<

iframe> code) are detected and left untouched to avoid corrupting embedded code
* Progress bar: the translation modal now shows an animated progress indicator while work is in progress

5.1.4

  • Fix Standard (Classic Editor) builder: apply wpautop() before regex extraction so plain-text paragraphs separated by blank lines get a

<

p> wrapper the extractor can capture. Without this fix, every Classic Editor page with non-tagged paragraphs (typical for legal pages, privacy policy, etc.) was being copied verbatim untranslated.

5.1.3

  • Enfold: extend the fullsize-container CSS patch to also reset the inner .container padding-left and padding-right to 0. Without this, the hero content kept a residual 20-50px lateral padding on the translated front page that the original home does not have

5.1.2

  • Fix front page resolver: Polylang Free filters option_page_on_front and returns the translated post ID directly. The previous check compared the result against the option value and aborted when they matched, leaving the translated front-page handler inactive. Now trusts pll_get_post() unconditionally
  • Without this fix v5.1.0 / v5.1.1 worked only when site_url was visited but the front-page template overrides did not apply on the translated URL

5.1.1

  • Suppress WordPress canonical redirect on /xx/ when serving the translated front page (was rewriting /xx/ to /xx/{slug}/ and bypassing front-page template)
  • Rewrite the permalink of the translated front page back to /xx/ so canonical links, menus and schema stay consistent
  • Fixes Polylang Free home rendering on themes with permalink-based canonicalization

5.1.0

  • Added Polylang Free compatibility for the translated front page: visiting /xx/ now serves the translated page through the active theme’s front-page template
  • Universal page-resolution layer (parse_query + template_include + body_class) works on any theme
  • Optional CSS patches for recognised themes (Astra, Enfold, Avada, Divi, GeneratePress) to hide breadcrumbs/title bars that are not present on the homepage template
  • Unknown themes keep their default rendering untouched: no breaking changes
  • Module activates only when Polylang is detected, current language is not the site default, and a translation of the front page exists

5.0.1

  • Improved plugin listing: updated description, tags and FAQ for WordPress.org
  • Enhanced admin UX: dynamic version display, clearer empty-state messages
  • Added review prompt after successful translations
  • Updated plugin header description

5.0.0

  • New extensible builder architecture: all content extraction now happens in the plugin
  • Added Builder Registry with priority-based detection (Elementor, Avia, Gutenberg, Standard)
  • Avia/Enfold builder: full shortcode-aware translation preserving layout, timeline, iconlist and all visual elements
  • Gutenberg block parser: translates block content while preserving block structure
  • Standard builder: template-based extraction with placeholder system
  • Server simplified to pure translation endpoint (receives text segments, returns translations)
  • Adding a new builder requires only 1 PHP file with no changes to existing code
  • Improved segment numbering to prevent merging of short text segments
  • Fixed shortcode attribute protection to prevent translating technical values

4.2.1

  • Improved Elementor translation with segment-based approach
  • Added smart detection for third-party Elementor addon fields
  • Added FontAwesome icon filtering to reduce unnecessary token usage
  • Added CSS value protection for gradients, transforms and other visual values
  • Added Elementor meta safety checks for edit mode, template type and version
  • Added WP Rocket cache purge integration
  • Improved WordPress coding standards compliance

4.2.0

  • Added batch translation support
  • Added translation cost estimator
  • Added glossary management
  • Added Polylang and WPML integration
  • Added low balance notifications

upgrade_notice.5.1.6: Adds automatic connection testing after saving credentials and polishes the settings UI (brand-orange buttons, centered icons). Safe to apply on all sites.
upgrade_notice.5.1.5: Recommended update. Translates SEO title and meta description, preserves inline formatting, rewrites internal links to the correct language, retries transient errors automatically, handles empty-body pages (like the WooCommerce Shop page), and prevents duplicated translations. Safe to apply on all sites.
upgrade_notice.5.1.4: Critical fix for Classic Editor: paragraphs without explicit tags (the default Classic Editor output) were not being translated. Upgrade to translate legal/privacy/cookie pages and any non-builder content.
upgrade_notice.5.1.2: Critical fix for Polylang Free: the front-page handler now actually activates on translated home URLs. Strongly recommended for any site using v5.1.0 or v5.1.1 with Polylang Free.
upgrade_notice.5.1.1: Fixes /xx/ redirecting to /xx/{slug}/ on Polylang Free, which prevented the front-page template from rendering on translated home URLs. Safe to apply.
upgrade_notice.5.1.0: Polylang Free front-page translation fix. Visiting /xx/ now serves the translated page through the theme's front-page template. Safe to apply on all sites; activates only when needed.
upgrade_notice.5.0.0: Major architecture upgrade. Content extraction now runs entirely in the plugin with a new Builder Registry system. Adds full support for Avia/Enfold and Gutenberg blocks. Existing Elementor and WooCommerce translations continue to work as before.
upgrade_notice.4.2.1: Better Elementor translation accuracy, third-party addon support, and WP Rocket cache integration.
upgrade_notice.4.2.0: New features: batch translation, cost estimator, glossary management, and Polylang/WPML integration.
